# case: no issues
cd tmp1
exec ssg doctor
cmp stdout ../no-issues.txt


# case: invalid directory layout
cd ../tmp2
exec ssg doctor
cmp stdout ../invalid_directory_layout.txt


# case: missing pandoc
env ORIGINAL_PATH=$PATH
env PATH=$SSG_PATH
cd ../tmp1
exec ssg doctor
cmp stdout ../missing_pandoc.txt
env PATH=$ORIGINAL_PATH
